asset_amount.unit_rule: Amounts from different asset_id values are never added.
asset_amount.gas_rule: Native gas has its own asset_id and budget.

invariants: One user-owned wallet belongs to one agent. An agent wallet has no cross-agent funding, inventory, or permission fallback.
Network access names Monad 143 or testnet 10143 explicitly. Approval for one network does not approve the other.
Each position binds to its owner, agent, wallet, network, strategy revision, and mandate. Each action also binds to one position or an explicit wallet-level owner flow.
A preview is current only while every bound identity, reviewed input, mandate, strategy revision, and review_hash still matches.
An unknown wallet-creation, transfer, or submission outcome is reconciled against its original identity before retry. Unknown submission retains reservations.
One unresolved economic transaction blocks a second economic transaction in the same agent wallet and network. Other agent wallets remain independent.
Mandate renewal preserves consumed allowances, reservations, positions, pending actions, losses, and stops. Expiry extension does not replenish a limit.
An action must pass both the exact strategy rule and the mandate ceiling. A broader mandate cannot enlarge a strategy rule.
A new strategy revision or signer binding does not restore revoked authority. Verified owner approval and current policy binding are required.
A pending or unknown signer removal blocks new agent submissions until the owner-authorized result and current binding are reconciled.

A broadcast-capable swap submission consumes one attempt, including a later revert. A confirmed success consumes reconciled input. A confirmed revert consumes actual gas; unused input is released only after reconciliation. A proved pre-broadcast denial consumes neither.

A qualified resend reuses the original signed bytes and hash and keeps the same economic action_id. A new provider request is recorded separately. Changed signed bytes or a new transaction are not a resend.
STOP_NEW_ENTRIES denies entries and additions. Existing exits remain eligible only under active, explicit authority. HALT_ALL_SWAPS also denies exits. Monitoring and reconciliation continue.
A stop applies before the first position exists and only to its recorded scope.
A Stop all agents request creates an explicit stop for each selected agent wallet. It does not create shared account authority.
Weighted average acquisition cost is maintained per position. External capital flows, realized results, estimated results, and gas remain separate.
Unknown required costs, basis, marks, authority, or provider restrictions remain unknown and block the affected claim or action.
